title: Acquos Masterbatch - recent acquisition of Clariant Masterbatch

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the acquisition.

body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition due to: - the relative low market share of the merged firm; - the relative low barriers to entry for the manufacture and supply of masterbatch; and - the potential for imports to act as a competitive constraint.
